It involves training \(N\) primal translation models \(f_i\) and \(N\) dual translation models \(g_j\), where \(i, j \in \{0, 1, \ldots, N-1\}\). The models are trained to map between domain \(\mathcal{X}\) and \(\mathcal{Y}\), and the final output is a single model \(f_0\) and \(g_0\) for inference. MADL extends this framework by introducing multiple primal and dual models. It was applied in Russian→English translation in the submitted systems [2].
